a.lede: A hacker obtained personally identifiable information about more than 40,000 Homeland Security staffers, which has since been published online.
a.title: Hacker stole personnel data about thousands of Homeland Security employees, including CBP and ICE agents

b.lede: A hacktivist group stole the information of ICE agents and border police from Homeland Security.
b.title: Hackers leaked details of more than 41,000 Homeland Security personnel
